## Foods & dishes
- [[WorldCuisines]]: 10 dishes, 0 Qatar-specific.
- [[RecipeDB2]] has one sample recipe "Al Harees … Traditional Qatari, Iraqi", but it is labelled Iraqi.
- Qatar is absent from [[ArabCulture]], [[BLEnD]], [[FmLAMA]] and [[World Wide Dishes]].

## Ingredients & food composition
- No FCT. Proxies: [[Saudi Food Composition Tables]], [[Bahrain Food Composition Tables]]. Candidates: [[EMFID (Eastern Mediterranean Food Information Data Bank)|EMFID]] (candidate, priority 1), [[MENA-150]] (candidate, Gulf dish images).

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[CMAUP]]: 3 plants (2 scraped). [[KNApSAcK Family]]: 11 records (1 edible / 10 medicinal).
- Compounds and health effects come only from the [[Global]] resources ([[FooDB]], [[CTD]], [[NPASS]], [[SpiceRx]]).

## Gaps
- No Qatari dishes, recipes, QA or composition data; everything must be borrowed from Gulf neighbours.
